verdict.rationale: Simular documents a self-healing behavior: when a saved step breaks because the UI changed, the agent takes over, which addresses state drift and failed steps in replayed skills. Nothing documents how popups are handled, what retry policy applies, or how wedged runs are detected and stopped. missing for 10: popup/dialog handling, documented retry semantics (counts, backoff, failure surfacing), recovery behavior for live (non-saved) tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the agent recovers from popups, state drift, and failed actions with documented retry behavior instead of wedging

citations.quote: saved code heals itself. When a step breaks because the UI changed, the agent takes over from there.
